description: Build script for a Rust project that downloads and processes external frontend dependencies, generates inlined assets, and sets runtime configurations such as RPATH for ODBC drivers.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main async function initializing the environment, creating a client, spawning download tasks, and setting RPATH.

methods.name: make_client
methods.description: Creates and configures an HTTP client with a timeout and no default headers.

methods.name: download_deps
methods.description: Downloads a file, processes it to inline remote dependencies, and writes a hashed filename.

methods.name: process_input_file
methods.description: Reads an input file, processes include comments to fetch remote files, and writes a compressed output.

methods.name: copy_url_to_opened_file
methods.description: Downloads a URL to a cache if not already cached, then copies it to the output.

methods.name: copy_cached_to_opened_file
methods.description: Copies a cached file to the output stream.

methods.name: download_url_to_path
methods.description: Attempts to download a URL to a local path with retries.

methods.name: hashed_filename
methods.description: Generates a unique filename based on the file content hash.

methods.name: make_url_path
methods.description: Creates a filesystem-safe path for a URL in the cache directory.

methods.name: download_tabler_icons
methods.description: Downloads an SVG sprite, extracts icons, and writes them to a Rust source file.

methods.name: extract_icons_from_sprite
methods.description: Parses an SVG sprite to extract icon IDs and contents.

methods.name: set_odbc_rpath
methods.description: Sets RPATH for ODBC drivers on Linux if the feature is enabled.
